title: Diagnosis and treatment of postoperative delirium and withdrawal syndrome, detection of brain abnormalities and developmental neurological outcomes in children with complex congenital heart defects.
summary:
Delirium is an acute functional disorder of the brain that occurs postoperatively in more than 20% of children in paediatric intensive care units. After heart surgery, the incidence in this age group is up to 50%. 
The primary aim of the project is to record the occurrence of delirium/withdrawal syndrome and risk factors that exist before, during and after surgery in cardiac patients in their first year of life and to correlate these with developmental neurological examinations (at 6–9, 12 and 24 months of age).
conditions: Congenital malformations of the circulatory system

interventions.name:
The study includes newborns and infants with congenital heart defects who undergo heart surgery within the first year of life.

Excluded are premature infants born before 36 weeks of gestation.
